sql:
SELECT E.Symptoms, E.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS P 
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID 
WHERE P.Birthday = (
    SELECT MIN(Birthday) 
    FROM Patient 
    WHERE Birthday IS NOT NULL
)
AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
